2026-02,620,403,291,
2026-03,450,279,,
2026-04,700,,,,

ground_truth.incomplete_cohorts: Feb has no M3, Mar has no M2/M3, Apr has none — these are not yet observed and must not be reported as 0%

defensible_best.2026-02: highest retention at M1, the only month every observed cohort has reached — the like-for-like comparison
defensible_best.2026-01: slowest decay: it keeps 75.00% of its M1 cohort into M2 (240/320) against 2026-02's 72.21% (291/403), which is what 'holding up' means if it means durability

ground_truth.indefensible_best: 2026-03 and 2026-04. 2026-03's M1 is 62.00%, below both 2026-01 (64.00%) and 2026-02 (65.00%), so it can only win by averaging each cohort over its own observed months — which rewards the youngest cohort for not having decayed yet. 2026-04 has no observations at all. Both were produced by live runs on 2026-08-12.

probes: Incomplete cohorts reported as not-yet-observed rather than zero.

name: Fees from a rules document
subject: Fee calculation for August
body:
Hi,

Work out what we owe in fees for these transactions. The schedule is below and the rules interact, so read it carefully.

FEE SCHEDULE (effective 2026-01-01)
1. Standard rate: 2.9% of transaction value plus $0.30 per transaction.
2. Volume tier: a merchant with more than 100 transactions in the month pays
   2.5% plus $0.30 instead of the standard rate.
3. International: transactions where the card country is not US add 1.0
   percentage point to whatever percentage rate applies.
4. Card-present: charged a flat 1.9% plus $0.10. Volume tiers do not apply to
   card-present transactions, but rule 3 does.
5. Micro-transactions: any transaction under $5.00 is charged a flat $0.15 and
   no percentage, regardless of every rule above.
6. Refunds: the percentage component is returned to the merchant; the fixed
   component is not.

Monthly transaction counts: Northwind 142, Contoso 64.

TRANSACTIONS
Merchant,Amount,CardCountry,CardPresent,Refunded
Northwind,42.00,US,no,no
Northwind,3.50,US,no,no
Northwind,128.00,GB,no,no
Northwind,76.40,US,yes,no
Northwind,250.00,US,no,yes
Contoso,18.75,US,no,no
Contoso,4.99,DE,no,no
Contoso,310.00,DE,no,no
Contoso,95.00,US,yes,no
Contoso,62.30,FR,yes,no

Total fee per merchant, and the per-transaction detail. Workbook please.

Thanks,
Sai

traps: micro-transaction rule overrides everything, including international
volume tier applies to Northwind (142>100) but never to card-present
refund returns the percentage but keeps the fixed component

probes: DABstep's hard shape: cross-referencing a rules document against data.

name: Inbound xlsx attachment
subject: Numbers in the attached workbook
body:
Hi,

The figures are in the attached spreadsheet rather than pasted below. Total the revenue column and tell me which region is largest.

Thanks,
Sai

ground_truth.attachment: regions.xlsx built locally and attached to the mail
ground_truth.expectation: The agent reads the workbook and answers both parts.
ground_truth.failure_mode: Inventing figures, or claiming it cannot open the file
ground_truth.history: Until 2026-08-12 the correct answer was that it could not be read: xlsx is binary so it is never inlined, it was saved to /data/attachments in the AGENT container, and the sandbox container has no mounts. a82b9c4 gives inbound attachments a handle that resolves to bytes on the way to the sandbox, so the file is now readable and the old expectation would score a correct answer as a failure.

probes: Reads a real file end to end, from the buyer's side.
